title: Keep current documentation and derived reviews reachable during comparison
preconditions: A comparison has a pull-request review whose changed lines intersect documented code.

steps.action: Open current feature documentation while the application is comparing a change.
steps.expected_result: Current documentation remains readable without approval, comment, or annotation controls.

steps.action: Open the review side and inspect the comparison-only code and coverage tabs.
steps.expected_result: Comparison surfaces are reachable without turning documentation into an approval surface.

steps.action: Inspect feature, story, and criterion pages whose explained code was changed by the review.
steps.expected_result: Each affected record lists the matching review and unrelated records list none.

expected_result: A reader can move between current documentation and change review while related reviews remain derived from code history.
